newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sage foreign issue raises $40 million.
newsitem.headline: Sage foreign issue raises $40 million.

text.p: South African insurance group Sage Group Ltd said on Tuesday it had successfully concluded a share issue to European investors, raising $40 million to help the expansion of its U.S. life assurance activities.

The new redeemable preference shares are convertible into ordinary shares at a price of 28.175 rand, an 18.4 percent premium to the average price of 23.76 rand of Sage's ordinary shares over the past five days. The stock closed at 24.05 on Tuesday.
The dividend yield on the shares to be issued will be 4.5 percent. The shares will be issued on June 30 and listed in Luxembourg.
Sage first announced last month it was planning an issue of $40-50 million of preference shares.
